thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: acme-east-1-vpc - GPU request queue length > 1200 and avg token-latency > 450ms over last 5m. Autoscaler reports 95% gpu_util per nodepool and 0 available pending nodes. paging Maria (oncall).
Maria: grabbing it. seeing big inflight queue on customer acme-east-1, pod backlog on gpu-pool-acme, autoscaler stuck at 8/8 desired.
Trent: looking at cluster events — node bootstrap timeouts: several nodes failed kubelet registration, imagepulls spiked. logs: `ErrImagePull: context deadline exceeded` on ak_gputools:latest.
Priya: that imagepull spike matches our registry rate limit bump earlier today. Are these private clusters using our mirror? acme uses customer-owned registry proxy — might be flakey.
Maria: confirmed, worker logs show repeated 504 from proxy. autoscaler requested new nodes but node bootstrap stalled waiting on container runtime. queue keeps growing. customer requests are timing out.
Kai: marking customer impact: degraded for 45m, some requests returning 503s intermittently. Estimate ~300 active requests failing.
Maria: mitigation options: 1) divert acme traffic to hosted fallback models (will cost but reduce customer errors); 2) temporarily increase reserved burst pool in region (needs infra manual); 3) manual node creation from pre-baked AMI (bypass registry pulls by using preloaded image).
Trent: quick check — pre-baked AMI exists (ami-0redwood-gpu-v2) for acme cluster but autoscaler policy prevents manual scale due to quota guard. we can request quota override from infra.
Priya: I can try a quick trick: taint low-priority jobs and evict to free up GPUs for customer. That frees ~2 nodes worth of GPU capacity in ~3m.
Maria: do it. Evict command: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l job=background -o name | xargs kubectl -n infra delete --grace-period=0 --force` — prefer safe eviction, but we need speed.
Priya: running eviction now. deleting 18 pods. pods terminating...
ops-bot: Event: 18 infra background pods deleted by Priya.
Trent: eviction freed up 16 GPUs, but autoscaler still shows warmup backlog: new pods pending because nodes are marked NotReady during imagepull retries.
Maria: next step: try manual bootstrap of 2 pre-baked nodes to replace failing ones. I will open infra escalation.
Maria: @infra oncall (cc Trent) — need manual node bootstrap in acme-east-1: 2x gpus with ami-0redwood-gpu-v2 and skip registry pulls. This is an incident mitigation.
Kai: pinging infra via email+pager: infra-ticket-5632 created, ETA for manual node spin: 12-15 minutes.
Trent: while we wait, route 25% of acme traffic to hosted fallback models — change route in routing-config: `ring: acme -> split: 25% hosted, 75% private`
Maria: making the routing change now. patched rollout target.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: routing-config v23 -> v24 (gradual 25%).
Priya: traffic shift successful, errors from acme clients drop ~40% already. but latency still high for the remaining private traffic.
Maria: infra reports manual nodes up, kubelet registered. verifying GPU runtime. logs show images present, no imagepull attempts.
ops-bot: Node acme-node-manual-01 registered, ready. Node acme-node-manual-02 registered, ready.
Trent: autoscaler metrics respond — pending pods now scheduling onto the two new nodes, queue drains. token-latency back to 210ms in 6m.
Maria: good. summary for handoff: root cause — registry proxy rate limits + imagepull storms caused node bootstrap failures, autoscaler attempted scale but nodes remained NotReady and hit cluster quota guard; backlog grew and customer saw 503s. Mitigations applied: eviction of low-priority jobs, routing 25% to hosted fallback, infra manual bootstrap of 2 pre-baked nodes. Current status: queue drained to <100, latency stabilized, customer impact reduced to low.
Priya: leaving follow-ups: 1) increase pre-baked node percentage for acme to 20% of pool; 2) add retry/backoff to imagepull logic and registry fallback; 3) infra to evaluate registry proxy config and rate limits.
Maria: assigning follow-ups to owners: Priya for pre-baked policy, Trent for autoscaler quota-gate fix, Infra (ticket-5632) for registry proxy fix.
Kai: oncall handoff at +30m — tagging next oncall: Trent (primary) and Maria (secondary).
Trent: ACK — I will take next shift. adding incident note to tracker: INC-2026-042: acme-east-1 GPU warmup bottleneck; root cause/regression label: registry-proxy-rate-limit.
Maria: closing live pager. Will post full postmortem once infra analysis done. :white_check_mark:
